About the role

Ajackus is building an AI-powered concierge platform for private members' clubs, and we are looking for a Senior AI/ML Engineer to own its intelligence layer.

Members message their club on WhatsApp, under the club's own name. An AI agent replies, makes bookings, takes payments, and introduces each member to the people they would benefit from knowing, with a clear reason behind every introduction. The platform is launching with private members' clubs and will expand to sports clubs, alumni networks, hospitality groups, and online communities.

You will own the AI service and its data architecture end to end, as the senior engineer in a small, focused product team at Ajackus.




Key responsibilities

Member intelligence and matching: Design the data architecture for people and relationships, and build reason-based matching (business, investment, advice, shared interests, friendship) that explains every introduction and improves from feedback, proven by evals.
Agentic concierge: Build end-to-end WhatsApp workflows for bookings, payments, club knowledge, and escalation, with reliable rules for when the agent acts, asks for confirmation, or hands over to a person.
User journeys: Map and build journeys for members, club teams, and internal users, each with a defined state, next step, and success measure.
Multi-tenant architecture: Enable new clubs and new verticals to be set up through configuration alone, with no code changes.
Security and trust: Enforce per-club data isolation, consent tracking, full erasure, a restricted store for sensitive data, audit logs for every agent action, and defences against prompt injection and data leakage, building towards SOC 2 and ISO 27001.
Performance and cost: Measure and reduce latency and token cost per turn through model routing, caching, prompt optimisation, and batching, while protecting quality with golden datasets, CI regression gates, and drift monitoring.



Must-have requirements

4+ years building production software, with substantial hands-on time on LLM systems that take real actions
Experience designing data architecture for people and relationships: profiles, graphs, and explainable matches
Recommendation, ranking, or matching systems in production, including systems that learn from feedback
Agentic tool use in production: multi-step workflows with confirmation, escalation, and failure recovery
RAG in production, with tenant-scoped retrieval and answers grounded in their sources
Multi-tenant AI systems with per-tenant data isolation and configuration
Security and privacy by design: access control, consent management, UK GDPR, data erasure, and audit trails
A proven, measurable record of reducing LLM latency and token cost without losing quality
Deep Python expertise and comfort owning an async production service
Exceptional written English and strong attention to detail in user-facing copy
Experience as the senior or sole owner of an AI service in a small team

Engineer

Job type: Full Time

Department: Engineering

Work type: On-Site

Chennai; Bengaluru

Charles Proteus Steinmetz was once called in to solve a problem with a massive electrical generator that no one else could fix.

After studying the machine, he made a small chalk mark indicating exactly where the engineers needed to make the repair.

His bill

for making the chalk mark.
for knowing where to put it.

We re looking for that kind of engineer.

We call this role The Engineer.


Not because the problems are small, but because the best engineers have an unusual ability to cut through complexity, identify the one thing that matters, and solve problems others struggle with for weeks.


At Kula, you ll work on some of our hardest problems across AI and agentic systems. You ll build intelligent systems that dont just assist humans, but reason, take action, and autonomously complete meaningful work.


This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who combines exceptional technical judgment with extreme execution speed.

What youll do

You ll build AI systems and agents that operate in the real world.

You ll take ambitious, ambiguous problems and turn them into working products - fast.

You ll experiment with LLMs, agents, tools, memory, reasoning, evaluation, and orchestration to push the boundaries of what autonomous systems can reliably do.

You ll own problems end-to-end: understanding the problem, designing the system, writing the code, shipping it, observing how it behaves, and improving it.

You ll know when a problem needs a sophisticated new architecture and when it needs a chalk mark.

You might be the Engineer if...

You have an unusual ability to find the root cause of complex problems.

You can take something from an idea to production faster than most teams can schedule the kickoff meeting.

You have strong opinions, but youre willing to throw them away when the data proves you wrong.

You dont measure your impact by lines of code or hours spent. You measure it by problems solved.

You are deeply curious about AI and agentic systems and are constantly building, experimenting, and learning.

You thrive in ambiguity. Give you a well-defined ticket and youll execute it. Give you a seemingly impossible problem and youll come alive.

You care deeply about craft but you understand that speed is a feature.

The bar

Were not looking for someone who simply knows how to call an LLM API.

Were looking for someone who understands how to turn rapidly evolving AI capabilities into reliable products that people can trust.

Someone who can move from first principles to prototype to production at exceptional speed.

Someone who can look at a problem everyone else thinks is complicated, make the right chalk mark, and say: "Fix it here."


If that sounds like you, wed love to meet you.
